nodes.title: SG-8.2.1 Block blank contribution submit with an inline message
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet.handleSubmit currently executes `if (prompt === '') return;`, so pressing Send with empty or whitespace-only text does nothing and the player gets no feedback. Desired behavior: block the submit and show an inline message 'Enter an idea first'. Expected result: no API call is made and the message is visible and announced. Why: players must understand why nothing was sent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the dialog is open and the textarea is empty, when Send is pressed, then 'Enter an idea first' is shown in an element with role=alert and submitContribution is not called
- Given the textarea holds only spaces or newlines, when Send is pressed, then the same message is shown and submitContribution is not called
- Given the message is shown, when the player types a character, then the message disappears and a valid idea still submits to the backend


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx blank-text validation message
- Out of scope: Max length counter and quota gating
- Out of scope: Backend API changes
- Out of scope: Visual restyling of the dialog
- Preserve: submitContribution and listMine API contracts
- Preserve: Server error messages from errorMessage
- Preserve: Existing Radix Dialog focus behavior
- Preserve: Trimmed prompt sent on valid submit


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript, existing ContributionSheet component
- No new dependencies
- No mock data replacing the real backend client


## Definition of done
- Blank and whitespace-only submit shows 'Enter an idea first' and sends nothing
- Message clears on typing
- Unit tests cover each acceptance criterion


## Non-functional requirements
- Message is exposed to assistive tech via role=alert and aria-describedby


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Blank or whitespace-only submit is blocked with 'Enter an idea first'
nodes.body:
Context: handleSubmit trims the text and silently returns when empty. Desired behavior: set a validation message 'Enter an idea first', render it inline under the textarea with role=alert, link it with aria-describedby and mark the textarea aria-invalid. Expected result: submitContribution is never called for blank text. Why: silent failure confuses players.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an empty textarea, when the form is submitted, then an element with role=alert has the text 'Enter an idea first'
- Given text of only spaces and newlines, when the form is submitted, then the same alert appears and submitContribution is not called
- Given the alert is shown, then the textarea has aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby pointing to the alert id


## Scope
- In scope: Validation state, blank branch and inline message in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Length limit
- Out of scope: Quota gating
- Preserve: Server error alert rendered from error state
- Preserve: Entries list behavior


## Technical constraints
- Keep the message separate from server `error` state so it can clear independently


## Definition of done
- Alert shown for blank submit
- No API call for blank submit


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessible error association


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The blank-text message clears on typing and valid submit still works
nodes.body:
Context: once the validation message is shown it must not linger. Desired behavior: typing in the textarea clears it, and a valid submit clears it and posts the trimmed prompt. Expected result: no stale message after correction. Why: a stale error would contradict the entered text.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the alert is visible, when the player types into the textarea, then the alert is removed and aria-invalid is not true
- Given the alert was shown, when the player enters ' hello ' and submits, then submitContribution is called once with 'hello' and no 'Enter an idea first' alert remains


## Scope
- In scope: onChange clearing and valid-submit clearing of the validation message
- Out of scope: Changing server error display
- Preserve: Trimming of prompt
- Preserve: Entry state labels Sending/Sent/Failed


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the validation state added for the blank message


## Definition of done
- Message clears on change and on valid submit


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add a new state hook `validation` holding the inline validation message, undefined by default, and a module constant BLANK_MESSAGE with the text 'Enter an idea first' placed after STATE_LABEL (L24).
steps.expected: Component compiles with the new state and constant.

steps.action: Replace the silent `if (prompt === '') return;` with a branch that calls setValidation(BLANK_MESSAGE) and then returns, so submitContribution is never called for blank text.
steps.expected: Blank or whitespace-only submit stores the message and does not call the API.

steps.action: On the textarea add aria-invalid={validation !== undefined} and aria-describedby={validation ? 'contribution-idea-error' : undefined}. Directly after the closing </form> render the message paragraph only when validation is set.
steps.expected: Inline alert 'Enter an idea first' appears after a blank submit and is linked to the textarea.
